description:
Follow-up to JMAP-sc1b.18 (which landed the workspace bench convention and the canonical bench in crate-jmap-server).

The MIME parser in jmap-mime is the second of three crates the .sc1b.18 review identified as worth benchmarking (large-message parsing, encoded-word decoding, MIME tree walking).

Pattern to copy from crate-jmap-server:
1. Add to crate-jmap-mime/Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies]:
     criterion = { version = '0.8', default-features = false, features = ['cargo_bench_support'] }
2. Add to crate-jmap-mime/Cargo.toml:
     [[bench]]
     name = '<bench-name>'
     harness = false
3. Create crate-jmap-mime/benches/<bench-name>.rs with criterion harness.

Suggested workloads:
- Small (1 KB) email parse — baseline.
- Medium (16 KB) multipart with three text parts and one base64 PDF attachment.
- Large (1 MB) multipart with deep nesting (5+ levels) to stress the tree walker.

Run with: cargo bench -p jmap-mime

Acceptance: at least one benches/<file>.rs target that compiles, runs to completion, and reports timings for at least three workload sizes.
